title: Document-Level Numerical Reasoning across Single and Multiple Tables in Financial Reports
authors: Yi-Cheng Wang; Wei-An Wang; Chu-Song Chen
why_relevant: Introduces a long-document financial QA benchmark and a multi-round RAG agent with verification, tangentially touching evidence localization in long contexts.
why_not_or_caveat: Focuses on numerical reasoning over financial reports, not on robustness to noise, conflict, adversaries, or calibration.
